suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as thromboembolic complication. Require documented DVT preceding separately documented pulmonary embolism. Do not infer PE from DVT alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) / Phlebitis and Pulmonary Embolism
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented DVT preceding separately documented pulmonary embolism. Do not infer PE from DVT alone.
